title: Paloma and the Bridge
author: Ulyana Amberdale
blurb: Jonah Yarrow, an apprentice clockmaker summoned to repair the observatory's master clock, believes history happens to other people, elsewhere. But when a child is left at the door with instructions to forget the face, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must keep a promise made in peacetime to someone now declared enemy before the ice breaks on the river.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
